items.title: Food-safety department suspends licences of nine KFC and Domino’s outlets in Hyderabad
items.text: After inspections of 26 outlets on November 12, Telangana food-safety teams reported hygiene and food-handling violations. Officials suspended the licences of seven KFC outlets and two Domino’s outlets and directed them to stop operating.

items.title: ACB investigation in Telangana uncovers assets allegedly worth over ₹25 crore
items.text: The Anti-Corruption Bureau arrested a deputy executive engineer after searches at 10 locations linked to a disproportionate-assets case. Officials said the market value of assets identified so far was estimated at more than ₹25 crore; the assessment was continuing.

items.title: IIT Kharagpur introduces NMC-accredited postgraduate MD programmes
items.text: IIT Kharagpur is introducing six MD specialisations with two seats each, for a total of 12 seats in the 2026–27 academic session. Admissions are through NEET-PG 2026 counselling at its Dr. B. C. Roy Multi-Speciality Medical Research Centre.

items.title: Telangana considers bringing Classes 11 and 12 under the regular school system
items.text: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy announced a proposal to end the separate intermediate-college structure and bring Classes 11 and 12 into the regular school education system from the 2027–28 academic year.

items.title: Proposed Hyderabad bus terminal brings Gajularamaram land encroachments into focus
items.text: A Telangana State Road Transport Corporation survey reportedly found that around 15 acres of its 100-acre Gajularamaram allotment had been encroached upon. Officials have sought district-administration intervention as plans for an international bus terminal move forward.
